propositions: Documentation must record the optional git-remote-s3 dependency and its installation via pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' with minimum version 0.3.2
docs/config.md must document that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix URLs served by git-remote-s3

docs/s3-backend.md must comprehensively guide operators through S3 setup including SSE-KMS bucket creation with customer CMK, versioning, public-access-block, IAM policy scoping, and git remote configuration
The S3 backend trust boundary relies on boto3 credential chain (not config storage), SSE-KMS encryption at rest, and IAM/SigV4 access control
The auto-doctor self-heals multiple-bundle merge states and stale locks via 60-second lock TTL (GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS environment variable, not the incorrectly-named GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL)

ADR 0093 must record the architectural decisions: git-remote-s3 integration below the git layer, SSE-KMS acceptability per requirements, merge-based auto-doctor rationale, and rejection of lower lock TTLs; ADR tooling (gen_adr_index.py, check_adr_numbers.py) must validate number/file bijection and regenerate the ADR index
